cobblemon.ability.eelevate.desc: Levitates and raises its highest raw stat after a knockout.
cobblemon.ability.gravitycontrol.desc: Intensifies gravity on entry while remaining airborne.
cobblemon.ability.souleater.desc: Restores HP when hit by Ghost attacks.
cobblemon.ability.chifocus.desc: Raises the critical hit rate of the user and allies.
cobblemon.ability.defragment.desc: Adjusts defenses according to a foe's offenses; the user's moves never miss.
cobblemon.ability.junglebeat.desc: Powers up sound moves, resists them, and treats Grass attacks as sound moves.
cobblemon.ability.hailwarning.desc: Summons hail on entering battle (legacy pre-Gen-9 Snow Warning).
cobblemon.ability.tempest.desc: Changes the weather on entry and before each end of turn; immune to weather damage.
cobblemon.ability.storm9.desc: Changes the weather on entry and before each end of turn; immune to weather damage.
cobblemon.ability.dragonize.desc: Normal moves become Dragon and deal 20% more damage.
cobblemon.ability.hotshot.desc: Attacks by and against the holder never miss; ball, shot and kick moves deal 30% more damage.
cobblemon.ability.solaridol.desc: Levitates; boosts Fire attacks and Attack in sun.
cobblemon.ability.lunaridol.desc: Levitates; boosts Ice attacks and Special Attack in hail or snow; immune to hail.
cobblemon.ability.swornduty.desc: Restores an ally’s HP upon entering battle.
cobblemon.ability.foamspray.desc: Lowers adjacent Pokémon’s Defense when hit.
cobblemon.ability.wildfire.desc: Damages non-Fire foes every turn and powers up attacks against burned targets.
cobblemon.ability.duskilate.desc: Normal moves become Dark and deal 20% more damage outside Glitch Field.
cobblemon.battle.weather.shadowsky.start: A shadowy aura filled the sky!
cobblemon.battle.weather.shadowsky.upkee: A shadowy aura fills the sky.
